name: settings-popover-carries-speed-and-quality
description: The gear opens the speed-and-quality popover specifically - the defect just fixed, pinned so the gear cannot quietly open a different overlay again.

steps.note: The gear at PlayerShell.cpp:346. The defect this pins was the gear not opening the popover that carries speed and quality.

assertions.note: The popover itself is hidden at construction (ShellWidgets.cpp:146), so visibility - not existence - is what says the click landed.
The SPEED half. playerSpeedSlider lives inside the flyout (ShellWidgets.cpp:167) and is not shown independently, so this can only pass when the speed-and-quality popover is the one on screen.

The QUALITY half, and the reason this manifest exists. qualitySection_ is built hidden (ShellWidgets.cpp:224) and only shown when options exist - setQualityOptions() sets it visible from !qualityOptions_.isEmpty() (ShellWidgets.cpp:284). The player is built with one quality entry at the manifest height, so a build that opened a flyout without its quality list fails here rather than passing on 'an overlay appeared'.

The discriminating check. The gear and the spark sit side by side in the same actionHost, and either press starts by dismissing the other overlay - so if the gear were wired to the enhancement tree, the positive assertions could still pass on a flyout left visible from an earlier interaction. This says the tree did not open.
